audionautExtension.title: Opus decoder (WASM)
audionautExtension.license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause (see notices inside the module)

codec.payloadLayout: u16le preSkip, u32le samples (48 kHz, after pre-skip), u8 channels, then repeated [LEB128 packet length][raw Opus packet]; no Ogg container

provenance.wasm: libopus (BSD-3-Clause) + puff inflate, inlined and compressed by upstream
provenance.licenceNotices: embedded as a header comment in the module (covered by the module hash)

tests.soundsDecoded: 96/96 from opus-pkt/1 payloads at 96 and 128 kbps
tests.vsFfmpegDecoder: max difference -85 dBFS (two decoders agree to about 2 LSB, not bit-identical)
tests.consequence: hash Opus by its stored bytes, never by decoded audio

notes: upstream opus-decoder repository ships no LICENSE file; MIT is taken from package.json and README
not used by any pack yet; inscribe now so Opus packs can be served later without engine changes
